name: AgroVida Automático Definitivo
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y postgresql postgresql-contrib && sudo install-php-extension pdo_pgsql pgsql && sudo service postgresql start && sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE mercado_agricola;" && sudo -u postgres psql -c "ALTER USER postgres WITH PASSWORD 'root';" && cp .env.example .env && sed -i 's/DB_CONNECTION=.*/DB_CONNECTION=pgsql/' .env && sed -i 's/DB_HOST=.*/DB_HOST=127.0.0.1/' .env && sed -i 's/DB_PORT=.*/DB_PORT=5432/' .env && sed -i 's/DB_DATABASE=.*/DB_DATABASE=mercado_agricola/' .env && sed -i 's/DB_USERNAME=.*/DB_USERNAME=postgres/' .env && sed -i 's/DB_PASSWORD=.*/DB_PASSWORD=root/' .env && composer install && npm install && npm run build && php artisan key:generate
postStartCommand: sudo service postgresql start && php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
